name: Incline Scapular Push-Up
steps: Place your hands beneath your shoulders on a bench and step back into a straight plank.
Keeping your arms completely straight and core braced, let your chest sink slightly toward the bench as your shoulder blades draw together.
Push the bench away until your shoulder blades spread around your ribs.
Let your chest settle back between your shoulders under control.
tips: Keep your arms long without forcing your elbows backward.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears or letting your lower back sag.
